group.label: Product page
group.comment: Configure rich snippets for product pages to improve search engine visibility. These settings enhance how your products appear in search results with additional information like pricing, availability, and reviews.

field.label: Delete wrong snippets automatically
field.comment: Automatically removes incorrect structured data from product pages. Helps maintain clean markup and prevent schema validation issues.

field.label: Enable rich snippet
field.comment: Activates structured data markup for product pages. This is the master switch for all product-related rich snippets.

field.label: Item name length
field.tooltip: The maximum value recommended by Google is 150. Values below 25 will default to 150. If the value is empty or 0, no limit is applied.
field.comment: Maximum character length for item name in structured data.

field.label: Item price
field.comment: Includes product pricing information in OpenGraph and Rich Snippets. Warning: disabling this will remove price from structured data and may cause Google Rich Results validation errors, as price is required for valid Product rich snippets.

field.label: Single price mode
field.comment: When enabled, uses schema.org Offer type with a single price value instead of AggregateOffer type with price ranges. This changes the structured data from multiple offer aggregation to a single offer representation.

field.label: Include price valid until
field.comment: This helps search engines understand price temporal validity and can improve accuracy in price comparison features. Useful for promotional pricing, time-limited offers, or regularly updated pricing structures.

field.label: Item description
field.comment: Controls which product description field is used in structured data. Select the most appropriate source for comprehensive product information.

field.label: Item description length
field.tooltip: The maximum value recommended by Google is 5000. Values below 25 will default to 5000. If the value is empty or 0, no limit is applied.
field.comment: Maximum character length for item description in structured data.

field.label: Item image
field.comment: Includes product images in structured data. This enables visual representation of products in search results and rich snippets.

field.label: Item availability
field.comment: Shows product inventory status in structured data. This helps communicate stock levels to potential customers directly in search results.

field.label: Payment methods
field.comment: Lists accepted payment methods in structured data. This provides transparency about payment options before visitors click through.

field.label: Delivery methods
field.comment: Includes shipping and delivery options in structured data. This helps set customer expectations regarding fulfillment methods.

field.label: Product category
field.comment: Displays category information in product structured data. This helps establish product classification context for search engines.

field.label: Manufacturer part number
field.comment: Includes manufacturer part numbers in structured data. This improves discoverability for specific product searches by technical identifiers.

field.label: Manufacturer part number attribute
field.comment: Specify which product attribute contains the manufacturer part number data. The system will read this attribute to populate structured data.

field.label: Brand attribute
field.comment: Specify which product attribute contains brand information. This maps your existing brand data to structured markup.

field.label: Model attribute
field.comment: Specify which product attribute contains model information. Helps identify specific product models in structured data.

field.label: Color attribute
field.comment: Specify which product attribute contains color information. Important for product variants and filtering in rich results.

field.label: Size attribute
field.comment: Specify which product attribute contains size information. Relevant for apparel and dimensional product data.

field.label: Material attribute
field.comment: Specify which product attribute contains material information (e.g. "material", "fabric"). Outputs as a direct schema.org property on Product.

field.label: Pattern attribute
field.comment: Specify which product attribute contains pattern information (e.g. "pattern"). Outputs as a direct schema.org property on Product.

field.label: Weight unit
field.comment: Select the standard measurement unit used for product weights. Ensures consistent weight representation in structured data.

field.label: Dimensions
field.comment: Enable dimensional measurements in structured data. Important for physical products where size matters to customers.

field.label: Unit
field.comment: Specify the measurement unit for product dimensions (e.g., inches, cm). Maintains consistency in dimensional representation.

field.label: Height attribute
field.comment: Specify which product attribute contains height measurements. Maps your height data to structured markup.

field.label: Width attribute
field.comment: Specify which product attribute contains width measurements. Maps your width data to structured markup.

field.label: Depth attribute
field.comment: Specify which product attribute contains depth measurements. Maps your depth data to structured markup.

field.label: Product condition
field.comment: Indicate whether products are new, used, or refurbished. This is important for marketplaces and resellers.

field.label: Condition attribute
field.comment: Specify which product attribute contains condition information. The system will read this attribute for condition data.

field.label: New attribute value
field.comment: Specify the exact attribute value that indicates a product is new. This maps your internal values to schema.org standards.

field.label: Used attribute value
field.comment: Specify the exact attribute value that indicates a product is used. This maps your internal values to schema.org standards.

field.label: Refurbished attribute value
field.comment: Specify the exact attribute value that indicates a product is refurbished. This maps your internal values to schema.org standards.

field.label: Damaged attribute value
field.comment: Specify the exact attribute value that indicates a product is damaged. This maps your internal values to schema.org standards.

field.label: Individual review markup
field.comment: Include markup for each individual product review. This enables rich display of review content in search results beyond aggregate ratings.

field.label: Add rich snippets for product variants
field.comment: Include structured data for product variations like different colors or sizes. This helps search engines understand your complete product offering.

field.label: GTIN-8 attribute
field.comment: Specify which attribute contains 8-digit GTIN/EAN codes. Important for international product identification.

field.label: GTIN-12 attribute
field.comment: Specify which attribute contains 12-digit GTIN/UPC codes. Standard for North American product identification.

field.label: GTIN-13 attribute
field.comment: Specify which attribute contains 13-digit GTIN/EAN codes. Common international product identification format.

field.label: GTIN-14 attribute
field.comment: Specify which attribute contains 14-digit GTIN codes. Used for packaging levels in supply chain identification.

group.label: Category page
group.comment: Control how category pages are represented in search results. These settings help search engines better understand your category structure and improve the display of category information in search results.

field.label: Delete wrong snippets automatically
field.comment: Automatically removes incorrect structured data from category pages. Helps maintain clean markup and prevent schema validation issues.

field.label: Enable rich snippet
field.comment: Activates structured data markup for category pages. This enables enhanced search result displays for category listings.

field.label: Category description
field.comment: Controls which description field is used in category structured data. Select the source that best represents your category content.

field.label: Category image
field.comment: Includes category thumbnail images in structured data. Helps provide visual context in search and social sharing.

field.label: Product offers
field.comment: Controls whether and how product information is included in category structured data. This can show available products within categories. Warning: "Entire category" mode outputs all products regardless of current page, which violates Google's guidelines requiring structured data to reflect visible page content, may be treated as spammy markup, and can significantly increase page load time for large categories.

field.label: Product offers format
field.comment: Determines how product data is formatted within category structured data. "Aggregate Product" outputs single Product schema with price range from whole category.

field.label: Brand name
field.comment: Brand name for aggregate Product schema. Leave empty to use store name or brand name for brand pages.

field.label: Include aggregate rating
field.comment: Include aggregated rating from all products in category for aggregate Product schema.

field.label: Exclude products with price 0
field.comment: When enabled, products with price 0 will be excluded from the aggregate offer calculation. This prevents lowPrice from showing 0 when category contains free products.

field.label: Enable OpenGraph
field.comment: Activates OpenGraph metadata for category pages. This controls how category pages appear when shared on social media platforms.

group.label: CMS page
group.comment: Manage rich snippets and OpenGraph data for static content pages. This helps search engines properly interpret your informational pages and improves how they appear when shared on social media.

field.label: Delete wrong snippets automatically
field.comment: Automatically removes incorrect structured data from CMS pages. Helps maintain clean markup on static content pages.

field.label: Enable rich snippet
field.comment: Activates structured data markup for CMS pages. This enables enhanced search result displays with schema.org types like WebPage, Article, BlogPosting, and more.

field.label: Default schema type
field.comment: Select the default schema.org type used for CMS pages when no per-page override is set. Individual pages can override this in the CMS page editor.

field.label: Enable OpenGraph
field.comment: Activates OpenGraph metadata for CMS pages. This improves how static pages appear when shared on social platforms.

group.label: Landing page
group.comment: Control how landing pages are represented in search results. These settings help search engines better understand your landing page structure and improve the display of landing page information in search results. Works with Mirasvit Landing Page only.

field.label: Delete wrong snippets automatically
field.comment: Automatically removes incorrect structured data from landing pages. Helps maintain clean markup and prevent schema validation issues.

field.label: Enable rich snippet
field.comment: Activates structured data markup for landing pages. This enables enhanced search result displays for landing page listings.

field.label: Landing page description
field.comment: Controls which description field is used in landing page structured data. Select the source that best represents your landing page content.

field.label: Landing page image
field.comment: Includes landing page thumbnail images in structured data. Helps provide visual context in search and social sharing.

field.label: Product offers
field.comment: Controls whether and how product information is included in landing page structured data. This can show available products within landing pages. Warning: "Entire landing page" mode outputs all products regardless of current page, which violates Google's guidelines requiring structured data to reflect visible page content, may be treated as spammy markup, and can significantly increase page load time for large categories.

field.label: Product offers format
field.comment: Determines how product data is formatted within landing page structured data. "Aggregate Product" outputs single Product schema with price range.

field.label: Brand name
field.comment: Brand name for aggregate Product schema. Leave empty to use store name.

field.label: Include aggregate rating
field.comment: Include aggregated rating from all products in landing page for aggregate Product schema.

field.label: Exclude products with price 0
field.comment: When enabled, products with price 0 will be excluded from the aggregate offer calculation. This prevents lowPrice from showing 0 when category contains free products.

field.label: Enable OpenGraph
field.comment: Activates OpenGraph metadata for landing pages. This controls how landing pages appear when shared on social media platforms.

group.label: Organization
group.comment: Define structured data about your organization for search engines. This information helps establish your business identity in search results and can enable special features like knowledge panel displays.

field.label: Enable rich snippet
field.comment: Activates structured data about your organization. This helps search engines understand your business identity.

field.label: Display scope
field.comment: Choose where organization schema markup should appear on your website.

field.label: CMS pages
field.comment: Select specific CMS pages where organization schema markup should be displayed.

field.label: Name
field.comment: Controls how your organization name is determined. Select default store name or specify a custom business name.

field.label: Name value
field.comment: Enter your organization's official name when using custom naming. This should match your legal business name for consistency.

field.label: Country
field.comment: Determines how your organization's country is specified. Important for local business structured data.

field.label: Country value
field.comment: Enter your organization's country name when using custom specification.

field.label: Locality address
field.comment: Controls how your organization's city/locality is determined. Important for local search visibility.

field.label: Locality address value
field.comment: Enter your organization's city or locality when using custom specification.

field.label: Address region
field.comment: Controls how your organization's state/province/region is determined. Helps with regional search relevance.

field.label: Region value
field.comment: Enter your organization's state, province or region when using custom specification.

field.label: Postal code
field.comment: Controls how your organization's ZIP/postal code is determined. Important for precise location mapping.

field.label: Postal code value
field.comment: Enter your organization's postal code when using custom specification.

field.label: Street address
field.comment: Controls how your organization's street address is determined. Provides detailed location information.

field.label: Street address value
field.comment: Enter your organization's full street address when using custom specification.

field.label: Telephone number
field.comment: Controls how your organization's phone contact is determined. Important for customer contact information.

field.label: Telephone number value
field.comment: Enter your organization's primary contact phone number when using custom specification.

field.label: Fax number
field.comment: Enter your organization's fax number if applicable. Optional contact method for business communications.

field.label: Email
field.comment: Controls how your organization's email contact is determined. Provides alternative contact information.

field.label: Email value
field.comment: Enter your organization's public contact email address when using custom specification.

field.label: Social media links:
field.comment: Enter full URLs to your social media profiles. These establish official connection between your website and social channels, helping search engines verify your online presence.

field.label: Legal name
field.comment: Enter your organization's full registered legal name, if it differs from the display name above. Helps search engines distinguish your official business identity.

field.label: Founding date
field.comment: Enter the date your organization was founded, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Used by search engines for Knowledge Graph and trust signals.

field.label: Number of employees
field.comment: Enter the approximate number of employees in your organization.

field.label: Area served
field.comment: Enter the geographic area your organization serves, e.g. "United States" or "Worldwide".

field.label: Contact points:
field.comment: Define dedicated phone/email contact points by department. These are added in addition to the general telephone/email above, and help search engines and users reach the right department directly.

field.label: Customer service email
field.comment: Controls how the customer service contact email is determined. Store information uses your Customer Support sender email.

field.label: Customer service email value
field.comment: Enter the customer service contact email address when using custom specification.

field.label: Sales email
field.comment: Controls how the sales contact email is determined. Store information uses your Sales Representative sender email.

field.label: Sales email value
field.comment: Enter the sales contact email address when using custom specification.

group.label: Breadcrumbs
group.comment: Enable structured breadcrumb data to help search engines understand your site navigation hierarchy. This improves site indexing and can enhance how breadcrumb navigation appears in search results.

field.label: Enable rich snippet
field.comment: Activates structured breadcrumb markup. This helps search engines understand your site hierarchy and may display enhanced breadcrumb navigation in search results.

group.label: Twitter card
group.comment: Configure Twitter card metadata to control how your pages appear when shared on Twitter. This helps optimize social sharing with appropriate images and descriptions.

field.label: Add Twitter summary card
field.comment: Controls which type of Twitter card to implement. This determines how your content appears when shared on Twitter.

field.label: Twitter username
field.comment: Enter your Twitter handle without the @ symbol. This associates your Twitter account with shared content.

group.label: Search box
group.comment: Enhance your site's appearance in search results by adding a search box directly in the search snippet. This can drive more targeted traffic through custom site searches.

field.label: Search box type
field.comment: Determines whether and what type of site search is featured in search results. This can encourage visitors to search your site directly from search results.

field.label: Path to the blog search
field.comment: Enter the URL path for your blog search functionality. Required when enabling blog-specific search in search results.

group.label: Answer Engine (AEO)
group.comment: Make the structured-data graph discoverable to AI answer engines (ChatGPT search, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews). When enabled, the emitted JSON-LD nodes carry stable @id values and are cross-referenced into one connected graph, so an answer engine can assemble a single confident entity from the page. When disabled, output is identical to the standard rich-snippet behaviour.

field.label: Enable Answer-Engine Optimization
field.comment: Adds stable @id values to each structured-data node and stitches them into one connected graph (Product references its brand and the selling Organization). Off by default; turning it on does not change which entities are emitted, only links them.
